description: This file defines the RelationshipService class, responsible for managing relationships between entities in the SuiteCRM API, including fetching, creating, and deleting relationships.

classes.name: RelationshipService
classes.description: Service class handling relationship operations such as retrieval, creation, and deletion of entity relationships within the SuiteCRM API.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves related entities for a given source bean, applying pagination and filters, and returns a structured JSON API response.

methods.name: createRelationship
methods.description: Creates a new relationship between source and related beans using provided parameters.

methods.name: createRelationshipByLink
methods.description: Establishes a relationship between two entities using a specified link name, with descriptive metadata.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Removes a relationship between source and related beans identified by ID, with exception handling if the relationship does not exist.
